text:
maria_ops: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered soft-drain for us-west1 GPU pool Tue 02:00 UTC -> 04:00 UTC. Goal: apply NIC microcode probe + nvlink sanity checks + BMC health resets with minimal impact.

alex_infra: how big are cohorts?

maria_ops: 3 cohorts, ~33% each, 30m drain window per cohort with 15m warm-backfill between cohorts.

toni_sre: is there a canary cohort first? want to validate KV cache warm seed & latency SLOs.

maria_ops: yes — cohort A is canary (low-traffic hosts). If metrics look good we proceed. rollbacks if p95 latency > 250ms or error rate +1%.

jlee_eng: I have a long-running training job on pool-2 (node g2-18). Can we exclude it?

maria_ops: pinged you in dm, jlee. We can tag node and skip for this window if it has stateful checkpoints. prefer graceful drain otherwise.

alex_infra: what about autoscaler settings? we should allow burst to dedicated reserved pool for 45m to avoid enqueuing.

maria_ops: agreed — temporarily increase dedicated burst cap to 15% for 02:00-03:00. schedulers will throttle best-effort jobs.

ryan_cost: rough cost impact estimate?

maria_ops: expected transient extra units ~4% for the window. ballpark $1.1k-$1.6k depending on burst use.

ryan_cost: ok, fine. please annotate cost center tag: infra-maint-2026-q1 so finance picks it up.

deploy-bot: scheduled: us-west1 GPU soft-drain (6162626263) added to maintenance calendar for 2026-03-24 02:00-04:00 UTC.

scheduler_simon: KV cache prime plan? we should pre-seed top-50 prefixes on canary after cohort A completes.

maria_ops: plan: after cohort A rejoin, run kvseed job with --prefix-file top50.txt and verify hit rate > 60% within 10m. snippet: 
```
./tools/kvseed --pool us-west1-canary --prefix-file top50.txt --concurrency 8
```

alex_infra: node cordon/drain commands (for oncall reference):
```
kubectl cordon $NODE && kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
```

toni_sre: add healthcheck: prometheus alert rule to mute non-critical noise but escalate p95/5xx. I'm drafting the alert update.

maria_ops: communications: we'll send a customer-facing blurb to status.redwood.ai (low-impact, maintenance) + internal notif in #support 01:45 UTC. Ops oncall to monitor.

jlee_eng: thanks — I'll checkpoint and opt to exclude my long training node.

alex_infra: oncall, please have rollback playbook handy (link): https://wiki.redwood.ai/playbooks/soft-drain-rollback

maria_ops: checklist for the window: 
- verify cohort sizing and cordon list
- increase dedicated burst cap (02:00-03:00)
- run canary drain + kvseed, validate SLOs
- proceed cohorts B/C with 15m gap
- post-window confirm KV hit rate and token-cost delta

toni_sre: ACK. I'll join the window to watch egress queues.

ryan_cost: tagged cost center.

deploy-bot: reminder set for 01:45 UTC: post internal maintenance notice.

maria_ops: final call — any objections?

alex_infra: none from infra. :thumbsup:

toni_sre: good to go. :white_check_mark:

jlee_eng: good on my side after excluding node.

maria_ops: thanks team — we'll run the soft-drain Tue 02:00 UTC. If anything changes I'll update here.
